request: the route publication and storage reclamation behaviour

defects.description: Publish replaces the head without comparing revisions. A delayed publication step silently replaces a newer published route plan with its older staged plan.

trigger.input: Prepare retained revision 1 with routes [old]; prepare retained revision 2 with routes [new]; run revision 2 publication, then revision 1 publication; call Current.

defects.why_missed: The publication suite stages and publishes revisions in increasing order. It checks copies and the head after each publication but never separates staging order from publication order.

defects.description: Candidates ignores the requested lifecycle state and returns every plan through the watermark. Sweep silently removes retained plans along with pending-deletion plans.

trigger.input: Stage retained revision 1, pending-deletion revision 2, and publish retained revision 3; Sweep(2); inspect Revisions.
trigger.actual: Sweep removes 2 plans; only revision 3 remains

defects.why_missed: All plans through the suite's sweep watermark are pending deletion; the retained current plan sits above the watermark, so the age-only predicate appears correct.
